summary: The supplied implementation satisfies the planned React architecture, task operations, validated localStorage persistence, responsive and accessible UI, and acceptance criteria. All 42 automated tests pass, and the production build exits with code 0. Logged storage errors are expected from passing failure-handling tests.
remaining_risks: Persistence remains unavailable when localStorage is blocked or full; the app continues operating in memory.
Concurrent browser-tab changes can overwrite stored tasks, as acknowledged in the original plan.
